requirements.checkable_result: the procedure's inputs are present at the recorded identity and the receipt records the observed result
requirements.edge_identity: the exact omitted edge is named, not only a count
requirements.identity_binding: the procedure is bound to the recorded candidate identity
requirements.procedure: a reproducible procedure a third party can run is named
requirements.reason: the argument states why the omission cannot affect the claim

bar.rule: an exclusion passes only when all five requirements hold; a row missing any requirement is counted as failing, and the output is the count of failing rows, never a reduced set

identity.digest_rule: closure receipts and their procedure inputs are read from the named commit, never from a later working tree

non_claims: A failing row is not repaired or removed by this record; it names an omission that must be closed or accepted explicitly.
A passing row establishes that the procedure can be run against the recorded identity; it does not establish that the procedure was re-run for this record.
The audit reads closure receipts; it does not re-run the closure engine or rebuild the candidate.
